# Planned Outage: PPR API - July 29 at 4:30PM

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**jessicamoll** (7/24/2025):

There will be a planned outage affecting the Personal Property Registry (PPR) API due to a scheduled upgrade of our databases. 

* Date: Tuesday, July 29, 2025
* Time: 4:30 PM PST
* Expected Duration: 2 hours
* Affected Services: PPR API (other services will remain operational)

Thank you for your cooperation.
